question:
The following bar graph shows the data of the number of students of different classes who like to eat different types of fruits

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8885d6f7d7f97597bf84c0b425f263a4a85fa7f3709c756e73a0949f3e9c0c64.png] 

What percentage of the students of class 8 mentioned here like guavas?
solution:
**Calculations:**

According to question,In class 8 we have ,

No. of students who likes guava = 10

No. of students who likes Orange = 20

No. of students who likes Mangoes = 30

Total students in class 8 = 10 + 20 + 30 = 60 

Now, percentage of no. of students who likes guava is = (10)/(60) × 100 = (50)/(3) = 16(2)/(3)%

**∴ Percentage of students who likes guavas is class 8 is 16(2)/(3)%.**
